reviews.comment: I took his Math 409H class. I dropped the class because his lectures were chaotic, and his grading sucked. He explained a topic I had previously learned, but way worse. I've made A's in all my classes and have never bombed a test so badly. I wouldn't have minded getting a B, but I could not spend any more energy/time just to bomb another exam.

Does not give adequate instruction for the material. Completely have to self study. Poor exam grader. He is not good and can not teach. Please take a different professor. If you believe all the negative reviews are because students couldn't handle the rigor and concepts of the course, think again, he is simply a bad professor.

Good luck!

This is for math 470. He is the absolute worst joke of an professor. Don't take this class unless you absolutely hate yourself. He doesn't know how to use any electronics, can't post grades, can't post lectures, can't talk, no email or office hours, no TA. Please don't take him if you care about your sanity and grade

reviews.comment: This rating is for MATH 470. This is the absolute worst professor you can take. He spans his work across three boards and none of it connects with each other. Every time you ask him a yes or no question, it is never a solid yes or no. His handwriting is terrible. He has a lenient grading scale, but don't let fool you. You learn better from videos.

reviews.comment: Very passionate but makes 0 sense in class. He seems to just dump on the board all he knows about the subject (Which is a lot), in a very difficult to understand manner. Textbook isn't required but recommended. He openly stated that he does not like any PDE textbook, and prefers to teach away from them. Don't ignore the bad ratings.

Awful with technology, expect to have technical issues with homework at least every other week. Put material on the homework and exams that we weren't expected to learn until a much higher level math course. Extremely vague with answers to any questions.

I had to self teach myself the entire thing. He has a thick accent and struggles to relate terms to things students can understand. I had to q drop with my engineering schedule as I did not have time to self teach the class

reviews.comment: Dr. Rundell is very passionate about what he's teaching and gives great lectures. His was the only class this semester that I always showed up and was attentive to. If you took MATH 470 and enjoyed some of the concepts, this class will be very rewarding. However, you really have to have a good study group to survive the homework/exams.

This was definitely the most difficult course I have ever taken. I feel that Rundell does an adequate job of explaining topics. He is understanding of students struggling, like myself, and he provided a lot of encouragement with sticking with the course. He is a bit of a tough grader, but he adjusts passing to be a 50.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: This was definitely the toughest course Ive taken so far. The first exams class average was around a 30. But Dr. Rundell is very passionate about the subject and is more than willing to help students outside of class with tough concepts. He exempts students with As from the final so he can focus on helping struggling students pass.
